title: A Yearbook for the Homecoming
author: Cyrus Dravenmoor
blurb: Silas Voss, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
